summary: Exact bottom-up tests refute a magnitude-only polynomial fan for R_spline. A complete assembly must also include the regular nine-element Q_{m;pq}=0 wall orbit; no complete A6 is claimed.
work_done: Built a fresh exact GMP BG oracle and attempted one rank-285 homogeneous degree-eight reconstruction on each of the eight unsigned magnitude words.
Found only 17/240 zero exact holdout residuals, disproving a single polynomial per unsigned magnitude word.
Reused eight validated round-3 branch polynomials for exact continuation tests: 96/96 same-Q controls agreed and 0/160 exactly-one-Q-flip probes agreed.
Restricted the continuation test to identical six energy signs: 21/21 controls agreed and 0/15 one-Q-flip probes agreed.
Recorded an explicit fixed signed labeled-order witness at omega=(21/2,-8,1,-7,-6,19/2), where only Q_{1;45} changes and the continuation residual is 411090099/8.
Stopped the downstream magnitude-only Möbius extraction because its mixed branch polynomials were invalid.
Created a corrected copy of round3_wall_trace_scan.json that deprecates the stale minus-only beta column without modifying the original.
next_steps: Reconstruct the two exact R_spline polynomial branches across an isolated Q_{m;pq}=0 wall while fixing the energy sheet and all pair signs.
Determine the order of vanishing and factor the resulting Q-wall quotient into compact symmetric blocks.
Integrate the joint q_{mp}/Q_{m;pq} fan, including intersections with the four-leg beta-minimum fan.
Only after the joint fan is controlled, solve for a common symmetric R0 and assemble the full A6 evaluator.

technician.batch: Eight exact full-sort reconstructions, adjacency/Mobius diagnostics, then a bounded fixed-branch refinement scan.
technician.outcome: The reconstruction and refinement artifacts completed. The magnitude-only Mobius extraction was stopped after the source interpolants failed exact holdouts.
